description: Emplois du gérondif, verbes et prépositions suivis du gérondif ou de l'infinitif.

questions.question: The salesperson admitted …… a mistake on those products and consequently accepted to pay us back.
Paul Stenson has called in sick but the foreman knows that he actually can't stand …… in shifts.
For Nobel Prize Kate Bullit, …… poetry has always been a mix of pleasure and suffering.
questions.explication: Le gérondif `writing` a la fonction de sujet et indique une activité.

questions.question: Julian Baker has been in charge of …… all the new sales representatives and executives of our branch.
questions.explication: *In charge of* (préposition) est suivi d'un gérondif : `hiring`.

questions.question: …… our selling strategy has been our top priority since the beginning of this year.
questions.explication: Le gérondif `Enhancing` a la fonction de sujet.

questions.question: Since he has quit ……, his complexion is much lighter.
questions.explication: *Smoking* est vu comme une activité ; *quit* est suivi du gérondif.

questions.question: …… the display at the entrance of the shop made us improve our sales by 15%!
questions.explication: `Placing` a la fonction sujet et doit être au gérondif.

questions.question: Due to his overdraft Mr. Tom Roberts had …… his 1895-dollar order.
questions.explication: *Had to* a le sens de « devait » et est suivi de l'infinitif : `to cancel`.

questions.question: The adman needs …… the whole team to introduce the customer's new product.
questions.explication: *Needs* n'a pas un sens passif ici (il y a un complément d'objet, *the whole team*) : infinitif complet `to gather`.

questions.question: Rain prevented the cast from …… the props.
questions.explication: *Prevent* se construit avec *from* suivi du gérondif : `using`.
